name: NPPES NPI Registry
summary: US healthcare providers and organizations by National Provider Identifier: names, taxonomies (specialties), practice and mailing addresses, other identifiers, refreshed daily by CMS.
notes: Keyless and read-only. version=2.1 is required on every call; older versions are retired.
At most 200 results per call (limit) and skip up to 1000, so a search yields at most 1,200 records; narrow the criteria for more.
enumeration_type and state cannot be the only criteria; country_code alone works only for a non-US country.
Name and postal-code fields take a trailing * wildcard after at least two characters.
An NPI does not mean the provider is licensed or credentialed.

endpoints.name: Search or look up providers
endpoints.summary: Providers matching an NPI, a name, a taxonomy description or an address, with full NPI records.

enumeration_type.description: NPI-1 individuals, NPI-2 organizations; needs another criterion.

name_purpose.description: Match names against the Authorized Official (AO) or the provider; both when unset.

first_name.description: Individuals only; trailing * after two characters.

use_first_name_alias.description: Include similar first names (Robert also finds Bob); default True.

last_name.description: Individuals only; trailing * after two characters.

organization_name.description: Organizations only; matches every name type (legal, DBA, former, other); trailing * after two characters.

address_purpose.description: Which address the address criteria match; any when unset.

city.description: City; APO or FPO for military addresses.

state.description: Two-letter state; needs another criterion besides enumeration_type and country_code.

postal_code.description: 5-digit codes also match ZIP+4; trailing * after two characters.

notes: addresses holds the primary practice location first and the mailing address second; other practice locations come in a separate practice locations array.
